theses.thesis: T1: Advanced-node and HPC mix keeps gross margin near 60% through 2026, so margin is not a cyclical casualty of the capex cycle.
theses.signpost: Reported quarterly gross margin at or above 58% in each 2026 quarter, confirmed in Q4 2026 results (early 2027). Invalidated by a gross margin at or below 56.1%, or a fall in 7nm-and-below share of wafer revenue.

theses.thesis: T2: Operating cash flow can fund the 2026 capex plan without a rise in debt, so the balance sheet stays net-cash.
theses.signpost: Trailing free cash flow above about NT$1.3 trillion in the Q4 2026 filing, with total debt flat near NT$1.06 trillion. Invalidated by total debt rising materially or net cash falling below NT$2 trillion.

theses.thesis: T3: Consensus earnings revisions keep rising, so the stock can grow into its forward multiple rather than rely only on rerating.
theses.signpost: FY2027 EPS consensus holding at or above US$23 and at least one more quarterly EPS beat in the Q4 2026 results (early 2027). Invalidated by a quarterly EPS miss, or more estimate cuts than raises over 30 days.
